معدات:
 Vertical Regenerative Air 
 Heater
 ليونجستروم

تسرد هذه الوثيقة 
فحص المعدات I1, of 
vertical rotary regenerative air heater, which must be, performed every month 
and six months as indicated by M1, M6 in the title block.

Regenerative air heater used for saving heat from flue gasses and use this heat 
for heating combustion air to increase boiler efficiency.

The first draft is 
prepared by eng. Abdalla Mohamed Abdalla. reviewed by directed by 
eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, 
accepted by general director eng. M. Abd El-salam, approved by eng: Michael Goerge: Head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and cretified by 
eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. Inspection and quality control Head Sector
